name: Love
message:
Thank you for being the most comfortable home I have ever known.
May this new year of your life bring every wish and dream true.
I will always be by your side, today and every day after.

I love you ❤️
reasons: You can make me laugh even on the hardest days.
You listen patiently, even when my stories run long.
The way you care about the little things.
You make me want to be a better version of myself.
Your smile changes the mood of the whole room.
You are warm, honest, and completely yourself.
